_comment: Single source of truth for Claude Code MCP servers registered by setup-linux.sh and setup-windows.ps1. Add new servers here; both setup scripts pick them up automatically. Args is a space-separated string of arguments passed after `--` to `claude mcp add`.
_history: 2026-05-25 SDD-007: removed `drawio` (rarely used for diagram gen, spawned subprocess even with --pure) and `socket` (mcp.socket.dev remote endpoint hung 30s+ on tool discovery). User decision: keep only hive + context7 + sequential-thinking across all environments (Claude Code, opencode, agy). 2026-06-02 HIVE-118: hive args flipped `uvx hive-vault` (per-session stdio) -> `hive client` (Phase C daemon proxy). A dedicated activation block in setup-linux.sh/setup-windows.ps1 migrates existing `uvx hive-vault` entries (the skip-if-present loop leaves them untouched) and installs the supervised `hive serve` service; gated on hive-vault >= 1.32.0.
